events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Rock
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, marks 55 years since its original release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple first introduced the revolutionary iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple unveiled the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the enduring film franchise.

angles.name: Bond Day Theme
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday Humour
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the inimitable John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', marks 58 years since its original release in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: A masterpiece of musical diversity. The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58 years old today.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' classic album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since we lost a true visionary. His music continues to inspire peace.
